description: This file defines the WeakPasswordException class, a custom exception used in the OpenMRS project to indicate that a password is too weak or matches forbidden criteria such as the username or system id.

classes.name: WeakPasswordException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PasswordException, indicating a weak password scenario.
